Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the value of benefits provided to any executive officer, employee, or director of a public service company.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the value of benefits provided to any executiveofficer, employee, or director of a public service company; and addinga new section to chapter 80.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The combined value of all cash and noncash benefits provided to anyexecutive officer, employee, or director of a public service companythat exceeds the annual salary of the governor of the state ofWashington shall not be recovered by the company in its rates orcharges.
